description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Master Mode], [Instant ATB 1], [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Ice/NE magic attacks, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% & Cap Break Level 3/4/5/6/7 to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Ice/NE med piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, [Cap Break Level 9, Instant Cast & Hero Boost +50%] for 1 turn to user, removes Master Mode
